functionality: The existing subject/preheader personalisation engine now discovers and substitutes approved variables in custom HTML, middle sections, headers and footers. No independent replacement engine was introduced.
Missing or invalid HTML first names render as there. Existing subject and preview-text fallback rules are preserved. Customer values are HTML-escaped; authored source is retained.

Unsupported and malformed variables remain explicit preview/send errors. Invalid in-progress HTML remains saveable as a draft. Existing legacy checkout preview conversion preserves personalisation variables and personalised image alt text.

Campaign preparation freezes personalised messages per verified recipient in the existing dispatch snapshot; campaign tests use the verified test recipient. Automation runtime and test paths use the same engine and existing recipient identity checks.

Customer-specific browser previews use server-generated escaped substitutions and recipient-scoped caches. Existing campaign preview customer selection is reused. The existing Shopify customer batch now includes firstName, without adding API requests.

Shared Settings / Editor / Templates navigation is 50px high, near-black with white labels and a gold active underline. It remains above the editor panel's own scrolling content; the preview retains its independent scroll area.
Native tab controls, keyboard navigation, autosave, draft state and lazy panel behaviour are retained. Conflicting automation-only navigation/mobile scrolling overrides were removed.
